items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: I'm looking at two brand new Carl Hauer bags there and he won't give me any.

ctx.x: That's ridiculous. It's your own business if you want to work five days.

Well, Uncle Sam is a tough man to work for. If you lose, I lost, I wasn't one day, I had a little bottle, a little vial, like, you know, with some kind of acid in it. Now, my bag had a corner of it, it had a hole in it about that big. Just big, large enough for me to lose it. And I caught myself putting this in there. I didn't want it on top. I didn't want it at the bottom. I knew I had to hold. So I put it in the middle. Well, as I went to the Carson, I know all the mill rooms in Chicago right now from that. I…
